# Folian Mac Public Beta 12

Folian Beta 12 brings the latest Studio writing and editorial work to the Mac app while keeping projects on your Mac.

- Draft chapters, sections, scenes and passages with more dependable autosave, manual save, paragraph spacing and recovery after a failed save.
- Use the Professional Editor to review a passage or selection, revise from a saved Review, edit proposed wording, accept the changes you want and apply them to the manuscript.
- Return to editorial History and open issues. Answer a question into Decisions, add a revision target or send a factual concern to Research.
- Plan with project-aware Story Map threads, beats and supporting points, then review their placement alongside your manuscript.
- Keep Research sources and verification separate from established project facts. Nonfiction editing protects uncertainty and rejects unsupported factual additions.
- Choose current GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna models or supported GPT-5.6 alternatives when your connected provider offers them.
- Find clearer first-session help and task-focused guides from the workspace.

Your existing local projects and writing remain in Folian's application-data folder when you update the app. Studio and Desktop keep separate project stores; they do not sync automatically.
